subject: Mental Models
title: Expected Value
description: Learn Expected Value in one minute.

hook.text: A lottery ticket costs $2 and pays $1 million. Should you buy it? That depends on the probability of winning.

buildup.text: Expected value is the probability-weighted average of all outcomes.

discovery.text: Blaise Pascal and Pierre de Fermat invented this concept in 1654 while solving a gambling problem through letters.

twist.text: A decision with negative expected value can still feel right.

climax.text: Use expected value to compare decisions objectively.

punchline.text: Multiply odds by payoffs. Choose the highest result.

quiz.question: How is expected value calculated?
options: Add all outcomes and divide by two
Multiply each outcome by its probability and sum
Take the most likely outcome as the answer
